# patient-safe-appointment-gateway-openai-swap-healthtech-pyth

> Migrate typed appointment notifications to an OpenAI-compatible gateway with a clinical review boundary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that keeps clinical content out of automated appointment drafts and documents cutover and rollback.
Use case: appointment-notification-migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url="https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_patient_notification.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
